name: PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk
summary: PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk oversees D'Monaco, a restaurant in Indonesia renowned for its European theme. This establishment serves as a versatile venue, accommodating a diverse range of private and corporate functions. These include celebratory events such as wedding receptions, birthday parties, anniversaries, pre-wedding photoshoots, and bridal showers, alongside professional gatherings like board and corporate meetings. It further caters to arisan meetings, fashion shows, and provides a distinguished fine dining experience, in addition to numerous other social occasions. In addition to D'Monaco, the company manages Sofia Residence, which offers European-inspired accommodations, and operates Insom lounges. Its business portfolio also extends to fish processing, café operations, and export activities. Founded in 2019, PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk has its headquarters in Sleman, Indonesia, and functions as a subsidiary of PT Goldman Investindo Sedaya.
